title: Ocotillo Reclamation Facility Rated For 18 MGD
summary: Chandler records the expanded Ocotillo facility as rated to provide 18 million gallons per day of A+ reclaimed water.
key_findings: The facility is described as operating after the expansion.
The 18-MGD figure is a rated capability.
Future expansion to 30 MGD is only an option.
why_it_matters: It distinguishes completed treatment capability from actual delivered volume.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: Design rating is not utilization, uptime, or customer allocation.
The record does not prove current industrial reuse at that rate.
